name: Aiko Nakamura
bio:
Aiko Nakamura's passion for motorsport ignited during her university years, where she excelled in mechanical engineering. After graduating at the top of her class, she joined a small Formula 3 team, quickly making a name for herself with her meticulous approach to car setup and data analysis. Her talent was soon recognized, and she was recruited by Joe Gibbs Racing as a junior engineer. 

Over the past few years, Aiko has steadily climbed the ranks, proving her worth through her exceptional problem-solving skills and unwavering commitment to performance. She thrives in high-pressure environments, meticulously analyzing every aspect of the car to extract maximum speed and efficiency. Aiko is known for her pragmatic and results-oriented approach, always seeking practical solutions that deliver tangible improvements on the track. Her dedication and sharp technical mind set her apart as a rising star in the world of motorsport engineering.

As Chief Engineer, Aiko focuses on maintaining a data-driven environment, while also emphasizing practical experience. She ensures that every engineer has the tools and support they need to excel, while also pushing them to think critically and creatively.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly bobbed with subtle layers framing her face.
physical.description: Aiko is a petite woman with a focused and intelligent gaze.
